Serialization

Titles, relation types, and diagnostics

mode: levels

A long title wraps and stops after three lines. The full title is in the tooltip. B -> A has the input type verifies with its own style. C -> A has the input type unknown without a style: it gets the default style. C relates to itself, and B -> A is given twice: the generator drops both and marks the nodes with a warning sign.

Built-in relation types: warning (dashed) marks a relation across levels, danger (red) marks a cycle. The "!" sign marks a node with a diagnostic.

Vertical lane at the height of a column gap

mode: structure

A3 -> B3 passes through at the height of the gaps. B1 -> A4 either crosses it once or goes around it. Over the top corridor and down the vertical channel between A and S, B1 -> A4 would cross A3 -> B3. Here B1 -> A4 goes around: from the bottom face of B1 down the vertical channel right of B, straight through the gap between B3 and B4 and under S, and up into the gap between A3 and A4. Both paths have four bends. The path over the top corridor is shorter by 104, less than two node heights, so the lengths count as equal, and the faces that look toward each other win: A4 lies below B1, so the bottom face of B1 and the top face of A4. The gap between B3 and B4 lies lower than the gap between A3 and A4, so A3 -> B3 makes a step before B3.

Pockets at the edges of containers

mode: structure

The short column of S4 and S5 stands at the right face of S, the short column of D1 and D2 at the right edge of the root. Both pockets border the outer vertical channel. A3 -> D2, S3 -> D2 and S5 -> D2 come up to the bottom face of D2 through the pocket of the root, nested. S3 -> D2 goes straight at the height of the gap between S2 and S3, through the pocket of S and out of the right faces of SR and S. A3 -> S5 enters S under SR and comes up to S5 through the pocket of S. It crosses S3 -> D2 once: the path over the top of S, into the gap between S4 and S5, has six bends instead of four.
